failureFocuses.qualityFocus: Stress answer-key integrity in near-neighbor control-flow cases. Make distractors differ by one observable state transition, keep options mutually exclusive, and require the explanation to name the evidence that rules out the closest distractor.

Stress source fidelity around aliasing, mutation, file state, recursion base cases, and class behavior. Refuse generic feedback: each explanation must contrast the keyed mechanism with one plausible but source-inconsistent mechanism.

Stress unsupported causal leaps, sequence errors, and answer choices that overlap across minerals, igneous processes, volcanism, weathering, and sedimentation. Explanations must identify the source observation that defeats the closest alternative.

Stress relative-versus-absolute evidence, process order, source omissions, and explanations that contradict their selected option. Every distractor must represent a distinct geologic inference rather than a paraphrase of another choice.

Stress closely related terminology, answer-feedback agreement, and misconceptions that must be genuinely false rather than copied source facts. Options should remain parallel across notation, interval, scale, rhythm, chord, and harmonic evidence.

Stress source coverage and conceptual boundaries where structure, ratio, scale pattern, chord function, progression, and form can be confused. Feedback must teach the distinction and must not merely repeat the keyed option.

Stress artifact-versus-method distinctions, ambiguous answer choices, and unsupported motive or cause inference from one behavior. Explanations must name why the keyed method fits and why the nearest plausible method does not.

Stress source omissions, generic key terms, invalid misconceptions, and feedback that is circular or non-instructional. Keep observations separate from interpretations and make insufficient evidence an explicit answer when the source does not warrant a stronger claim.

conservativeCapacityProjection.interpretation: Capacity planning only: the projection combines the observed source-candidate yield with the 95% Wilson lower bound from the first 100-case judgment. Actual capture, admission, and two clean-room orders may produce fewer or different preferences.

claimBoundary: This receipt proves only that a balanced, failure-targeted, holdout-disjoint capture plan has enough conservative projected capacity to pursue the 54-row preference shortfall. It contains zero new model calls, comparisons, judgments, preferences, training rows, or adapter weights.
